title: Master’s Linguistics Course
text:
This page records the history of my involvement in the course of the Linguistics Master’s Program at the Faculty of Humanities, Udayana University.

2025 - now

Morfologi (Morphology) (Course coordinator: Prof. Dr. Ni Luh Sutjiati Beratha; Members: Prof. Dr. I Nyoman Udayana ✝︎; Gede Primahadi Wijaya Rajeg, Ph.D.) - I am teaching the Corpus-based approach to morphology, using the Indonesian corpora as the data source - From Odd Semester 2025/2026
Etika dan Metode Penelitian Bahasa (Ethics and Methods in Language Research) (Course coordinator: Prof. Dr. I Wayan Pastika; Members: Gede Primahadi Wijaya Rajeg, Ph.D.; Dr Ni Made Ayu Widiastuti) - I am filling in for the Corpus Linguistics method - From Even Semester 2024/2025

title: Co-authored publications
text:
This page records the history of my involvement in co-authored publication(s) with the Linguistics Doctoral Students at the Faculty of Humanities, Udayana University.

2025

Widiastuti, Ni Made Ayu, I Made Rajeg, Gede Primahadi Wijaya Rajeg, Ketut Artawa & I Nyoman Udayana. 2025. Model analisis pola metaforis dan pemetaan metafora konseptual. Denpasar, Bali, Indonesia: Bali Nusa Creative. (A part of doctoral dissertation project by the first author) - the first, second, third and the fourth authors are members of the CompLexico research group



2024

Widiastuti, Ni Made Ayu, Ketut Artawa, I Made Rajeg, I Nyoman Udayana & Gede Primahadi Wijaya Rajeg. 2024. Selecting representative data samples from corpus collection with specific target domains. The International Journal of Social Sciences World (TIJOSSW) 6(1). 225–237. (Paper) - the first, second, third and last authors are members of the CompLexico research group
